personal.name: Swarup Saha
personal.headline: Technical Lead & Full Stack / GenAI Engineer

summary: Technical Lead and Full Stack / GenAI Engineer with 12.4 years of experience building scalable web applications and AI-powered systems. Deep expertise in MERN/MEAN stack, LangChain, LangGraph, Azure OpenAI, and Agentic AI/RAG pipelines. Proven track record delivering multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ML models, and LLM-based products at enterprise scale. Skilled at leading cross-functional agile teams and owning full SDLC from design to deployment.

projects.label: Zeltri (Multi-Tenant Elder Care Management Platform)
bullets: Architected a multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS platform for care homes and assisted-living providers using MERN stack, FastAPI, MongoDB Atlas, Redis, and Azure; enforced strict tenant isolation, RBAC/ABAC security, and scalable REST APIs across 10+ facilities.

Integrated Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Orchestration & RAG pipelines using LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, LangSmith, and Azure OpenAI with MongoDB Atlas as vector stores to enable semantic document search, email intelligence, conversational assistance, and automated task workflows.

projects.label: CV (AI-Powered Social Media Reels Generation)
bullets: Developed an end-to-end AI-powered content pipeline for automated Reels creation across YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook; integrated Azure OpenAI (script generation), multilingual translation, Whisper (TTS), Midjourney (image gen), and RunwayML (video render), reducing production cycles by 60%.

projects.label: PlanITRoI (Refurbished Laptop Price Prediction & Specification Extraction)
bullets: Designed microservices-based data pipelines using Node.js, Python, and PostgreSQL with event-driven processing for large-scale web scraping and data normalization.
Developed ML models for spec extraction and price prediction using KNN with fuzzy logic, Random Forest, and LLM-assisted enrichment, improving pricing accuracy and catalog quality.

projects.label: Sizeright (Shoe Measurement & Sizing Solution)
bullets: Built a cloud-native Flask web widget on AWS for real-time shoe sizing; developed scalable RESTful APIs with predictive ML models (Random Forest, KNN) for accurate measurement recommendations.

experience.title: Technical Lead
bullets: Developed an ML model (Random Forest + XGBoost) for Brightside to predict loan eligibility and detect fraud by analyzing credit scores, employment, and financial history.

Built a serverless, cloud-native backend on AWS Lambda, Node.js, and MySQL for scalable loan evaluation services; implemented CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and enforced security best practices including SQL injection prevention, XSS protection, and rate limiting.
Authored unit tests and integration tests using Jest, Chai, and Mocha to ensure code coverage and vulnerability remediation across critical loan processing modules.
Designed and implemented ETL pipelines using Python and AWS Glue for automated data extraction and transformation, streamlining ML model training workflows.

Developed full-stack features with React, Redux, Node.js, and integrated AWS Lambda, Amplify, S3, API Gateway, and EC2 for scalable policy data access; managed deployments via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines and wrote unit tests using Sinon, Supertest, and Mocha.
